_status: NOT DEPLOYED — PROPOSED / FOR REVIEW ONLY. Has not been applied to any environment. The live pipeline 9c7b26bd-11f3-432f-a7df-a30b56a8955f is unchanged.
_comment: AZURE_SQL drop-only filter set. Every processor is a DROP rule mapped to a line item in the governance decision paper (Filtering of AZURE_SQL, 20/08/2026). No allowlist/keep inversion is used.
_governance: Decision: FILTER HEAVILY. Priority P2. Target retain ~20% of 34.526 GB/day.
_updates: Pipeline id 9c7b26bd-11f3-432f-a7df-a30b56a8955f (supersedes the 2-rule live definition in azure_sql_filter.json).
_ordering: Cheapest/broadest drops first. A record dropped by an earlier rule never reaches later rules.
description: Azure SQL Log - heavy filtering per governance decision 20/08/2026

processors._rule: D1 — operational, performance and health telemetry categories
processors._grounded: Keys on 'category', proven present in this feed (live filter already matches it).

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"category\":\\s*\"(DatabaseWaitStatistics|QueryStoreWaitStatistics|QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics|ResourceUsageStats|Timeouts|AutomaticTuning|WorkflowRuntime|Blocks|Deadlocks|SQLInsights|DatabaseInstances)\"")

processors._rule: D2 — SQL audit batch-start markers (the paired COMPLETED event carries the signal)
processors._grounded: Carried forward unchanged from the live filter.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"BATCH STARTED\"")

processors._rule: D3 — successful routine DML (SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE)
processors._maps_to: 7.5/12.3: Routine SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE; Normal application-generated database activity; Routine business transactions
processors._guard: Only drops when succeeded=true, so FAILED statements (probing, permission denials) still reach SecOps.
processors._confirm: Confirm the 'statement' field name in this feed's parsed events before deploying.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"(BATCH COMPLETED|RPC COMPLETED|TRANSACTION COMMITTED)\"") and IsMatch(body, "(?i)\"statement\":\\s*\"\\s*(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|MERGE)\\s") and IsMatch(body, "\"succeeded\":\\s*\"?true\"?")

processors._guard: Only successes are dropped. LOGIN FAILED / DATABASE AUTHENTICATION FAILED are untouched and continue to SecOps.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"(DATABASE AUTHENTICATION SUCCEEDED|LOGIN SUCCEEDED|CONNECTION CLOSED)\"")
